lineage: Kiki-only Telegram source metadata, Node 24 pinned IPv4 compatibility, WeChat send receipt and quoted-message repairs, Feishu MP4 file/video outbound separation and inbound group metadata, multipart rich-message/caption preservation, and inbound transport recovery over nb-im-session/1; WeChat source fixes also live in tasks/task-0045-im/platform-source/nb-im (version 0.2.0).
scope: Preserve Telegram update IDs for deduplication and add source metadata. Keep pinned IPv4 lookups in single-address mode for Telegram polling, sending, downloading and outbound notifications. Confirm WeChat sends from HTTP 200 ret=0 or nonempty message_id without explicit error; carry the quoted item ID and bounded text separately. Separate Feishu kind:file .mp4 attachments (file_type:stream + msg_type:file) from kind:video native sends (file_type:mp4 + msg_type:media without required image_key), preserve SDK HTTP rejection/unknown outcomes, attach Feishu inbound mentions/reply/timestamp metadata, extract ordered text and media from Feishu post messages (direct and locale-wrapped), coalesce OneBot/Realtime multi-segment and multi-attachment messages into ordered multipart payloads, and preserve captions when media downloads fail or exceed limits. Enable the Feishu SDK's authenticated ping/pong watchdog and automatic reconnect, and report reconnecting/running through the existing adapter state. Bound Telegram and WeChat long polls with cancellable absolute deadlines; consecutive 429 and transport failures use the existing bounded backoff. The default WeChat transport's 35-second silent empty response settles before its 40-second outer guard, while injected transports retain a 35-second default guard. OneBot sockets own cancellable 30-second ping and 10-second pong watchdogs: forward sockets reuse the session reconnect loop, while reverse sockets drop only the failed role and keep the listener available for a replacement. Credential handling, conflict/auth terminal states, receive-then-cursor ordering and unknown-outbound no-replay semantics are unchanged.
rebuild: node vendor/nb-im-patches/telegram-metadata/rebuild.mjs (prints a new scratch tarball; copy it to vendor/nb-im-core-0.3.0-kiki-im-metadata.tgz and update pnpm-lock.yaml integrity)
test: Rebuild runs the Telegram, WeChat, Feishu, OneBot, Realtime, extended-media and session-loop suites and pinned-ipv4.test.mjs against generated JavaScript.
licenses: Original NOTICE and LICENSES are retained unchanged in the archive.
